title: Oven Roasted Jamaican Flour Flatbread
description: A satvik-friendly Jamaican dish featuring flour, smoke, and nostalgic flavors, with a jammy and cheese-pull twist. This recipe combines traditional ingredients with a modern twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the grated cheese, jam, and smoked paprika to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 6 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Brush the tops with olive oil and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15 minutes or until the flatbreads are golden brown and crispy.
